resources.string: Close locked apps when the screen turns off

Uses Shizuku to force-stop locked apps when the screen turns off or you use Lock all now. They stop playing media and won\'t get notifications until you open them again. System apps, your launcher and keyboard are never closed.

Closes locked apps that are running in the background when the screen turns off or you use Lock all now. The app you were using may keep running; with Shizuku every locked app is closed. System apps, your launcher and keyboard are never closed.

Needs Shizuku: since Android 14, apps can only close other apps through Shizuku. With it, locked apps are force-stopped when the screen turns off and won\'t get notifications until you open them again.
